method: Analyst application of LAIF v1.2 principal text, not engine-generated findings or empirical certification
framework_drafting_issue: Section 2.4 says three properties; Sections 2.5 and 9.1/9.4 require the fourth, Structural Calibration. All four included; framework and engine unchanged.

au_dta_policy_v2_1.principal_gap: Mandatory administrative controls do not themselves establish equally enforceable individual protections or a four-property deployment evidence gate.

eu_ai_act_amendment_2026_1744.principal_gap: Equivalent protection for affected classes during deferred/legacy application intervals is not demonstrated; strong existing explanation and stop/override rights are expressly credited.

boundary: Insufficient evidence cannot establish an affirmative LAIF threshold; it does not prove the opposite proposition or statutory noncompliance. No tested deployment, institutional breach or legal invalidity finding.
